biography: 1. Kingfisher is the former name of Ann Arbor based indie folk band Racing Mount Pleasant prior to switching their name in 2025. 2. Kingfisher is a Dutch math/post improvisation-jam band from Delft, Leiden and Utrecht. Influences range from bands like Toe and Owls to Ghosts and Vodka and I'm not a gun. Bandmembers include: Edoardo-guitars, Pim-bass, Sebastiaan-drums Kingfisher is also a dutch rock band. http://www.kingfisheronline.nl https://www.facebook.com/Kingfishernetherlands (Read more on Last.fm.
